description_en: Calls CreateOsVersion to create a system upgrade version
description_zh: 调用CreateOsVersion创建系统升级版本
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc create-os-version --is-force-night-upgrade N --project-id P0VFCREU --device-model-id 12 --system-version 2.0.1-R-20180501.1208 --is-milestone N --is-force-upgrade N --night-upgrade-download-type 1 --night-upgrade-is-show-tip N --night-upgrade-is-allowed-cancel N --rom-list 0_http://www.oss-server.com/file1.zip,2.0.1_http://www.oss-server.com/file2.zip --enable-mobile-download Y --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOsVersion

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force a night upgrade. Valid values: Y | N.

This parameter and IsForceUpgrade cannot both be set to Y at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制夜间升级，取值：Y | N。

与强制升级不能同时选择是（Y）
parameters.name: is_force_night_upgrade

parameters.help_en: The maximum version code of the OTA SDK allowed
parameters.help_zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最大版本versioncode
parameters.name: max_client_version

parameters.example: 改用UI用户体验，提升系统稳定性
parameters.help_en: The release notes for the version
parameters.name: release_note

parameters.example: 版本备注信息，终端设备不可见
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The blacklist of system versions, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 系统版本黑名单列表，英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: black_version_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether this is a milestone version. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.name: is_milestone

parameters.help_en: The minimum version code of the OTA SDK allowed
parameters.help_zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最小版本versioncode
parameters.name: min_client_version

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of system versions, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 系统版本白名单，英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: white_version_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force an upgrade. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制升级，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: is_force_upgrade

parameters.help_en: The download type for night upgrades. A value of 1 indicates download over Wi-Fi only. A value of 2 indicates download over any network
parameters.help_zh: 夜间升级下载类型。1表示WIFI下下载，2表示任全网下载
parameters.name: night_upgrade_download_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display a prompt dialog box during a night upgrade. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: night_upgrade_is_show_tip

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the night upgrade can be canceled. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 夜间升级是否允许取消，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: night_upgrade_is_allowed_cancel

parameters.help_en:
The list of upgrade packages, including full and incremental packages, in the format `baseVersion|romUrl,baseVersion|romUrl`.

baseVersion is the baseline version.

If the package is a full package, set the baseline version to 0.
If the package is an incremental package, set the baseline version to the baseline system version number
parameters.help_zh:
升级包列表，包括全量包和增量包，格式为`baseVersion|romUrl,baseVersion|romUrl`。

其中，baseVersion为基准版本，

如果是全量包，则基准版本为0。
如果是增量包，则基准版本为基准的系统版本号
parameters.name: rom_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow downloading upgrade packages over a mobile network. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许移动网络下载升级包，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: enable_mobile_download

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of packages allowed for download over a mobile network, in MB. When mobile network download is allowed, packages larger than this limit are not automatically downloaded
parameters.help_zh: 允许移动网络下载的包的最大限制，单位为M，在允许移动网络下载包的情况下，大于该限制的包也不会自动下载
parameters.name: mobile_download_max_size

VersionId.description_en: The ID of the created version
